sculpture.title: Auguste couronné de chêne / museum object Ra57

sculpture.identityLimit: The sculpture identity is grounded in the creator page and museum model. Byte identity to the creator’s working mesh is unknown.

priorSource.relationship: Replaces this component’s credited Lee Perry-Smith stand-in. Existing HeroRecreationStudy and other source actors are preserved.

normalization.formula: Position X/Z centered on original axis bounds; Y offset by min; all divided by original Y span. No nonuniform deformation.

qem.errorScope: Independent orthographic silhouette tests at 400/675 px across 0/90/180 degrees: IoU≥0.99858, maximum boundary distance≤1.414px. This does not prove original-film pixel equivalence.

contours.simplification: Horizontal section curves of the reviewed museum QEM; per-plane RDP tolerance0.0006world units, quantization≤1/60000. One closed two-point zero-area path was omitted.
contours.rendering: Density selects 62–186 original planes. Arc-length serif ribbons use bounded WebGL1 Uint16 batches; no bitmap sculpture or new illustration.

camera.method: Independent normalized source-ink silhouette-row profile fit over five corresponding full-head states. Camera is fitted, not recovered.

writing.text: Two original Latin Res Gestae excerpts (§§1/34), public domain; independently placed, not a copy of the selected film’s English translation.
writing.fontStack: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif
writing.linuxFixtureFace: Liberation Serif 2.1.5, confirmed with the exact locked Nix FONTCONFIG_FILE; no claim that Linux rendered licensed Times New Roman.
writing.limit: Exact source wording, glyph metrics, row starts, camera and contour spacing are not recovered.

observedMovieFacts: Frame0 begins with a partial lower-neck assembly.
Resolved head turns during the middle sequence.
Late departure removes lower writing before upper-head fragments.
Frame271/9.0333s begins a new lower-neck entry before the9.6s loop boundary.
timing.fittedMasks: Two observed states (frames36/1.2s and252/8.4s) supply coarse 24-height×24-arc occupancy fits. Independent per-cell admission/erase deadlines connect these states; a short initial arc write-on preserves lower-neck re-entry. Continuous original trajectories are not recovered.
timing.unchangedControls: 12 property controls; no pointer or invented scroll story. Loop duration scales the selected9.6s phase.

coarseAdmissionMap.sampling: Projected outward-facing museum contours; source 720 px luminance averaged in 15×15 px neighborhoods, threshold 8/255. Back-facing unobserved bins do not imply source absence.
coarseAdmissionMap.channels: Red=entry coverage, green=exit coverage, blue=0, alpha=255. Binary coverage only; no source text or glyph bitmap is embedded.
coarseAdmissionMap.runtime: One 2304-byte nearest-filtered texture in the existing WebGL renderer; no new context, renderer or RAF.
coarseAdmissionMap.fitLimit: Only two temporal states ground the occupancy table. Latin placement and between-state row/arc deadlines remain independent fits.

sharedRuntime.preserved: RGB resolver, complete v2 per-window coordinator, surface hook, static/Canvas gates and controls are unchanged apart from attribution text.
sharedRuntime.limits: At most 2 WebGL contexts including initialization,1 live editor/2 live Preview; Canvas default off,12 fps/1 MP Canvas opt-in, serial stills≤2 MP. Existing resolution-adequacy cache and sharp handoff are retained.

cacheRevision.behavior: The existing v2 content key already includes this private setting. A keyed private surface remounts its factory when the revision changes; shared hook/coordinator/RGB bodies remain unchanged.
cacheRevision.proof: Without a revision the same-filename negative control reused obsolete head pixels without invoking the new factory. Revised cache handoff and real React preserved-identity/key swap both matched a fresh Augustus still with one new factory call and peak 1 context.

validation.status: PASS: focused locked Nix source/strict/browser/real-pixel and HMR regressions; actual Framer save/reload paint remains pending.
validation.mixedScope: 60 placements per legacy/new coordinator leader, minimum head ink/detail plus resource/cleanup checks; unchanged old actor retained.
validation.reason: This is source/test provenance. No connected browser automation or Framer write is performed by this change.
